run_download_dataset_cli: run the CLI to download coco2017 dataset to data/coco with 4 threads
run_download_coco2014: run the CLI to download coco2014 dataset with unzip and delete options
run_download_voc2012: run the CLI to download voc2012 dataset to a custom save directory
run_download_objects365v2: run the CLI to download objects365v2 dataset with multi-threaded patch downloads
run_download_ade20k: run the CLI to download ade20k_2016 dataset with semantic segmentation annotations
